newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 8.196 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 77-day T-bills yield 8.196 percent at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 77-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.196 percent versus 8.21 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.

The bank also tendered NZ$100 million of 91-day seasonal treasury bills at a weighted average yield of 8.18 percent, compared with 8.171 percent for NZ$125 million of 100-day seasonal bills tendered last week.
Bids for the 91-day seasonal bills totalled $290 million.
The weighted average yield for $75 million of 175-day regular Treasury bills was 8.014 percent versus 7.991 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for NZ$50 million of 392-day treasury bills was 7.866 percent versus 7.796 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
